create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a GTN graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs with weights
set_and_get_graph_weights: set graph arc weights using a Python list or NumPy array and retrieve them
create_scalar_graph: create a scalar graph from a single weight value using gtn.scalar_graph
run_differentiable_ops_with_backward: run add subtract or negate on graphs and compute gradients with gtn.backward
run_parallel_ops_on_graph_list: run negate add concat or remove in parallel on a list of graphs
